d:
In this video, we continue our USA road trip and visit one of the most interesting and controversial places in American history, Rajneeshpuram, the city established by Indian spiritual leader Osho in Oregon.
We started our journey by exploring Antelope, a small American town that became famous during the 1980s because of the Rajneesh movement. From there, we travelled towards the actual location of Rajneeshpuram, where thousands of Osho’s followers once lived.
